scope: process-stage faults observable from GD32 sensors + upstream AI outputs (AI-1/2/3/4). Composition faults are out of scope -> off-device model.

classes.name: NORMAL
classes.query: sintering on profile normal crystalline single phase well
classes.mechanism: All modalities within the host's normal sintering profile.

classes.name: RAMP_TOO_FAST
classes.human: Heating ramp too fast — thermal stress / unreacted intermediate
classes.query: heating rate ramp fast thermal shock crack cracking intermediate phase incomplete reaction solid state calcination
classes.signature: AI-3=fast_ramp, AI-2 temp-residual high, ramp_C_per_min above sintering_profiles baseline
classes.mechanism: Excessive ramp rate causes thermal gradients / cracking and skips intermediate solid-state reaction steps, trapping secondary phases.
classes.action: Reduce ramp rate to the host profile value; add an intermediate dwell through the reaction window.

classes.name: UNDER_TEMPERATURE
classes.human: Under-temperature / short hold — incomplete reaction, amorphous/secondary phase
classes.query: sintering temperature soaking time insufficient low temperature incomplete crystallization amorphous secondary phase unreacted calcination duration
classes.signature: AI-3=undertemp, AI-1 still 'charged' not 'done', peak T below sintering_profiles sinter.temp_C
classes.mechanism: Peak temperature or soak time below the host requirement leaves the reaction incomplete -> residual precursor / amorphous / secondary phase, weak luminescence.
classes.action: Raise peak temperature or extend the soak to the host profile; verify with XRD before accepting.

classes.name: OXIDIZE_CR6
classes.human: Cr3+ -> Cr6+ oxidation — dead NIR emission + toxic aerosol
classes.query: Cr3+ Cr6+ chromium valence oxidation state reducing atmosphere oxidizing air emission quenching hexavalent chromium near infrared activator
classes.signature: gas=Cr6+ sev>=2 at >900C in oxidizing atmosphere; AI-2 gas residual high
classes.mechanism: In an oxidizing atmosphere at high T, NIR-active Cr3+ oxidizes to optically dead (and toxic) Cr6+, killing the emission and releasing Cr6+ aerosol.
classes.action: Switch to a reducing/inert atmosphere (e.g. 5%H2/N2) or lower the peak temperature; ventilate.

classes.name: DECOMP_GAS_SURGE
classes.human: Precursor decomposition gas surge — porosity / off-stoichiometry / hazard
classes.query: carbonate decomposition CO2 nitrate NOx ammonium NH3 evolution gas release calcination weight loss porosity precursor decomposes outgassing
classes.signature: gas=CO2/NOx/NH3/HF at species onset temp; AI-2 gas residual high during early ramp
classes.mechanism: Carbonate/nitrate/ammonium precursors release CO2/NOx/NH3/HF on heating; a too-fast ramp through the onset traps gas (porosity) and can shift stoichiometry, plus a safety hazard.
classes.action: Slow the ramp through the decomposition window and ensure venting before continuing to peak.

classes.name: VOLATILIZATION_LOSS
classes.human: Volatilization loss at high T — off-stoichiometry / secondary phase
classes.query: volatilization evaporation MoO3 sublimation Ga2O3 gallium loss alkali volatile high temperature stoichiometry deviation excess compensate sealed crucible
classes.mechanism: Volatile oxides (MoO3 sublimes, Ga/alkali loss) escape at high T, leaving the product off-stoichiometric -> secondary phases / reduced emission.
classes.action: Add excess of the volatile component or use a covered/sealed crucible; cap the peak temperature.

classes.name: MOISTURE_HYDROXYL
classes.query: moisture water adsorbed hydroxyl OH group quenching non radiative humidity hygroscopic dehydration drying precursor water content luminescence quenching
classes.signature: humidity high, AI-2 humidity-residual high before/at charge
classes.mechanism: Adsorbed water / OH groups introduce high-energy phonon non-radiative pathways that quench NIR emission.
classes.action: Dry / pre-calcine precursors; load under low humidity.

classes.name: GRIND_INHOMOGENEITY
classes.human: Grinding / mixing inhomogeneity — secondary phase, uneven emission
classes.query: ball milling grinding mixing homogeneity homogeneous agglomeration particle size uniform precursor mixture intimate mixing inhomogeneous
classes.signature: stage=grind, vib RMS abnormal (AI-3 vibration channel)
classes.mechanism: Poor mixing leaves local stoichiometry gradients -> secondary phases and spatially uneven emission.
classes.action: Re-grind / extend mixing cycles to the host grinding_cycles.

classes.name: SOAK_TEMP_DRIFT
classes.human: Soak temperature drift / instability — inconsistent crystallinity
classes.query: temperature fluctuation stability furnace control drift uniformity thermal gradient grain growth holding isothermal soaking instability
classes.mechanism: Furnace instability during the isothermal hold causes grain-growth variance and inconsistent crystallinity batch to batch.
classes.action: Check furnace PID / heating element; recalibrate before next batch.
